(c-declare "static unsigned long binding_glo_reads, binding_prm_reads, binding_glo_writes;")
(define binding-reset! (c-lambda () void "binding_glo_reads=0; binding_prm_reads=0; binding_glo_writes=0;"))
(define binding-glo-count (c-lambda () unsigned-long "___result=binding_glo_reads;"))
(define binding-prm-count (c-lambda () unsigned-long "___result=binding_prm_reads;"))
(define binding-write-count (c-lambda () unsigned-long "___result=binding_glo_writes;"))
;;; Paired workload: identical file for old and new embedded GSI.
;;; Composed mode uses the already-present processor-placement helper.
;;; No imports or runtime headers; -f suppresses user initialization.
(define count 4096)
(define composed?
  (member "--composed" (cdr (command-line))))
(define caller (current-thread))
(define caller-processor (processor-id (current-processor)))
(define target-start-processor #f)
(define callbacks 0)
(define resumed 0)
(define crossed 0)
(define latencies (make-f64vector count 0.0))
(define (request-value i)
  (if composed?
      (let ((resume #f))
        (if (not (eq? (current-thread) target)) (error "request logical target" i))
        (set! callbacks (+ callbacks 1))
        (if (not (= caller-processor (processor-id (current-processor))))
            (set! crossed (+ crossed 1)))
        (let ((turn (call-with-current-continuation
                     (lambda (k) (set! resume k) 0))))
          (if (< turn 2)
              (begin (set! resumed (+ resumed 1)) (resume (+ turn 1)))
              (let ((payload (vector i (cons i i))))
                (thread-send caller payload)
                payload))))
      i))
(define gate (make-mutex))
(define changed (make-condition-variable))
(define ready #f)
(define finished #f)
(define target
  ((if (and composed? (member "--place-target" (cdr (command-line)))
            (> (##current-vm-processor-count) 1))
       (lambda (thread) (##thread-start-on! 1 thread))
       thread-start!)
   (make-thread
    (lambda ()
      (set! target-start-processor (processor-id (current-processor)))
      (mutex-lock! gate)
      (set! ready #t)
      (condition-variable-signal! changed)
      (let wait ()
        (if (not finished)
            (begin (mutex-unlock! gate changed 5) (mutex-lock! gate) (wait))))
      (mutex-unlock! gate)))))
(mutex-lock! gate)
(let wait ()
  (if (not ready)
      (begin (mutex-unlock! gate changed 5) (mutex-lock! gate) (wait))))
(mutex-unlock! gate)
(binding-reset!)
(write
 (cons 'REQUEST-SERVICE-COST
       (##exec-stats
        (lambda ()
          (let loop ((i 0))
            (if (= i count)
                i
                (let* ((start (time->seconds (current-time)))
                       (n (thread-interrupt! target (lambda () (request-value i)))))
                  (f64vector-set! latencies i (- (time->seconds (current-time)) start))
                  (if composed?
                      (begin
                        (if (= (modulo i 256) 0) (##gc))
                        (let ((message (thread-receive)))
                          (if (not (and (eq? message n) (= (vector-ref n 0) i)
                                        (= (car (vector-ref n 1)) i)))
                              (error "composed request/mailbox result" i n))))
                      (if (not (= i n)) (error "request cost result" i n)))
                  (loop (+ i 1)))))))))
(newline)
(write (list 'BINDING-COUNTS (binding-glo-count) (binding-prm-count) (binding-write-count)))
(newline)
(mutex-lock! gate)
(set! finished #t)
(condition-variable-signal! changed)
(mutex-unlock! gate)
(if (eq? (thread-join! target 5 'timeout) 'timeout) (error "cost target not drained"))

(if composed?
    (begin
      ;; Logical target identity is the contract. Scheduler migration may move
      ;; a parked target to the caller's processor; physical affinity is not.
      (if (not (and (= callbacks count) (= resumed (* 2 count))
                    (<= 0 crossed count)))
          (error "composed delivery/placement counts" callbacks resumed crossed))
      (write (list 'REQUEST-SERVICE-TOPOLOGY caller-processor target-start-processor crossed callbacks resumed))
      (newline)
      (write (list 'REQUEST-SERVICE-LATENCIES latencies))
      (newline)
      (display "REQUEST-SERVICE-COMPOSED-PASS count=4096 resumes=8192 explicit-gc=16 mailbox-identity drained\n")))
fixturePacket.scope: Generated-host GLO/PRM reads and SET_GLO writes only; p1 window from immediately before the request report to immediately after it, before teardown. Runtime library accesses are not counted. Instrumented timing is not a production-cost sample. Original4096 requests, composed8192 resumes and16 explicit GCs; same profile and30/300s caps.

instrumentation.scope: Generated GLO_/PRM_ macro definitions wrap their unchanged original expression in a counter comma-expression; generated SET_GLO call sites use a wrapper that counts then executes the original macro. Counters are plain native integers on p1. No runtime function pointer, collector, root representation or configuration is changed.

request-only.scope: Generated-host operations only; library requests/GC/FFI operations excluded. Page bounds assume the admitted existing global pages, as required by successful module binding.

composed.scope: Generated-host operations only; library requests/GC/FFI operations excluded. Page bounds assume the admitted existing global pages, as required by successful module binding.

mechanisms.proof: The qualified mem.o primitive_ref calls __emutls_get_address at0x90b0 before checking current PSTATE, RC owner, open phase and joined_round. Each counted PRM reaches the exported service through the generated macro.

Qualified mem.o contains two distinct relocations to ___global_page at0x9114 and0x912c. primitive_cell and primitive_flag resolve the same VM/global identity independently; acquired directory reads prevent treating these as one proven compiler lookup.

Current ordinary reads resolve stable VM storage through the acquired page directory; the matched old role uses its earlier direct ordinary-cell layout. The operation counts are equal, but per-operation implementation differs.

The new record has6 payload words versus2 in the matched old request vector:4 extra words,32 bytes on64bit,131072 payload bytes per4096 requests. This is not a measured total/peak allocation increase.

causalBoundary: These are proven added mechanisms and execution counts, not an instruction-cycle attribution of all21.14%/41.26% regression. Instrumented timing is excluded. Remaining effects include runtime/library calls, request state/locks, code generation, GC and scheduling. The latest uninstrumented paired data remain the timing authority.

netCondition.correctness: All required ownership, multi-shot continuation, moving-root and failure-custody obligations must hold first.
netCondition.time: For a declared workload mix with measured weights wi, positive throughput benefit requires sum(wi * (Told_i - Tnew_i)) >0 under the same accepted inputs/profile. Existing historical failures from a different source period contribute no amortized savings.
netCondition.memory: Physical peak and retained-debt budgets must independently hold; invalid carrier-local byte counters cannot supply this premise.

nextCompleteRuntimeCut.owner: VM binding read activation and source lifetime
nextCompleteRuntimeCut.replacement: Move repeated owner proof and identity-to-storage resolution to actual context/module admission and safe-point refresh; publish a VM-owned binding view consumed by generated hosts. Read current ordinary/primitive values and override-presence bits with their required memory order. No cached moving Scheme values.
mustClose: All generated PRM/GLO and raw runtime/FFI readers use the same declared owner boundary.
Bind VM/module/activation identity, safe-point refresh and root freeze; drain readers before VM cleanup.
Preserve shared immutable templates plus VM-local mutable primitive overrides, late rebinding and old-module refusal.
Keep PointId, frame roots, tail transfer and multi-shot continuation restoration.
Account view/pointer-table memory and fallback/unknown custody; compare clean native timings separately from diagnostic counts.
